subject: website
name: Fileverse Walkaway
summary: Fileverse Walkaway, which recovers dDocs and dSheets when Fileverse's own apps are offline, open source (AGPL-3.0). It makes no request when it opens and runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: recovering documents reads the chain through public RPC endpoints (Gnosis Chain, Alchemy) and files through IPFS gateways.

connections.name: RPC endpoints (rpc.gnosischain.com, Alchemy)
connections.note: Used during recovery, without a light client.
